participation.context: Enjoyed the story, said the twenty pounds are expected and not his, and paid fourpence.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Moved his elbows, allowed the end, and would not let expected money eat.
participation.name: Alice Brambleby

participation.context: Told the hamper and the glove, asked after the twenty pounds in the same voice, laughed loudest, and paid for his own.
participation.name: Will Kemp

relations.quote: This dinner is fourpence, and the fourpence is mine.
Do not tell the twenty pounds as if they were in my purse.

story.body: You heard Kemp out, once his elbows were in, and you heard the question in the same voice. You said the money is expected. Alice named the dinners it has never paid for. You and Kemp each paid fourpence.

relations.quote: This dinner is fourpence, and the fourpence is mine.
Do not tell the twenty pounds as if they were in my purse.

title: Said the Queen's twenty pounds are expected, and paid fourpence
